_comment: Config-driven agent/model registry for the GEAK standalone runtime. Two orthogonal axes: 'agents' (how to drive a code-agent CLI, model-independent) and 'models' (an endpoint, CLI-independent). A 'profile' pins one (agent, model) combo. See COMPAT_findings.md R1-R7 for the fields that must be confirmed per CLI with `<cli> --help` at bring-up. Flags below are best-effort defaults; override any without editing code via env (GEAK_<CLI>_* / GEAK_QWEN_EXTRA_ARGS) or a backends/<name>.mjs escape hatch.

qwen.note: non-interactive auth needs ~/.qwen/settings.json {security.auth.selectedType:'openai'}; OpenAI-compatible via OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL; verified against SaFE gateway + claude-opus-4-8 2026-07-31.

codex.note: Rust bin: wire_api=responses. Provider is AUTO-CONFIGURED via `-c model_providers.geak_auto.*` overrides (no hand-written config.toml). Resolution: (1) explicit OPENAI_BASE_URL (or the selected model's base_url) is used directly; (2) else key-driven auto-SELECT walks provider_autoselect and picks the first provider whose trigger_env is set — AMDKEY->AMD (adds Ocp-Apim header), SAFE_API_KEY->SaFE, OPENAI_API_KEY->OpenAI official. Disable with GEAK_CODEX_AUTOCONFIG=0; a base_url on 127.0.0.1/localhost keeps the config.toml safe_shim path; GEAK_CODEX_EXTRA_ARGS with model_provider= wins. SSL_CERT_FILE still needed for intranet-gateway CAs (not public OpenAI).

kimi.note: official kimi-cli (PyPI, install via uv --python 3.13). OpenAI-compatible via ~/.kimi/config.toml (type=openai_legacy, default_model). --quiet=print+final-only, --afk=unattended auto-approve. Needs SSL_CERT_FILE for gateway CA. prompt is the value of -p (last arg); model via config default_model (generic path omits -m to keep -p<prompt> adjacent).

cursor.note: AgentKernelArena-style cursor-agent CLI (--force --print). Auth via cursor-agent's own login / CURSOR_API_KEY in env; runs on Cursor cloud (NOT SaFE gateway); no base_url. Model = Cursor-side id (e.g. sonnet-4-thinking). Verify --output-format/model against `cursor-agent --help` at bring-up; stream-json parsing may be needed if text mode is noisy.

_models_comment: SaFE gateway (OpenAI-compatible) models — all reachable at the same base_url with a SaFE ak- key in OPENAI_API_KEY. Verified via /v1/models 2026-07-31. base_url is applied to the agent's base_url_env; the key stays in env (never in this file).

openai_official.note: Official OpenAI (api.openai.com). Standard Bearer auth via OPENAI_API_KEY (sk-...); public CA, no shim, no APIM header. `id` is a REQUIRED placeholder — set GEAK_CODEX_MODEL to a real OpenAI model your account serves over the Responses API (e.g. gpt-5.x). Do NOT use a gateway id like gpt-5.6-sol here — api.openai.com does not serve it and codex 404s. Pair with codex config provider `openai` (see codex-home/config.toml).
